responsibility: This file implements management of temporary directories and intermediate files used by libgccjit compilation. It creates a secure per-compilation temp directory, constructs canonical fake.c/fake.s/fake.so paths, tracks extra dump or ahead-of-time output files, and deletes or preserves them depending on the KEEP_INTERMEDIATES option, with separate Windows and non-Windows creation paths. It owns filesystem-level scratch-space lifecycle for playback and result generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements tempdir creation and teardown declared in jit-tempdir.h, including mkdtemp or win_mkdtemp use, construction of fake.c/fake.s/fake.so paths, and cleanup or preservation of files. Unlike the header, this .cc file performs the filesystem operations for the scratch directory.
